theme_cn: 作文跟读 + 阅读理解 + 语法练习 + 听力对话 + 键盘拼写

writing_drill.title: 第 1~3 句 · 开头与邀请
writing_drill.focus_cn: 先把 I'm writing to you because… 读顺，再接住邀请句

sentences.en: Dear Toni, I'm writing to you because I'm going swimming this Saturday.
sentences.cn: 亲爱的Toni，我写信给你是因为这周六我要去游泳。

sentences.en: Would you like to come with me?
It would be great to do some exercise at the weekend.
sentences.cn: 周末做些锻炼真是太好了。

listening_name: 听力：听对话 + 听写填空

reading.passage: In China, many people pay with their phones instead of cash. You open a payment app, scan the QR code in the shop and type the amount, and the money leaves your wallet in a second. Small shops like this way because they do not need to keep much change. Even people who sell vegetables in the street use it. Some grandparents find it hard at first, so their children teach them step by step. Now they can buy breakfast with a single tap, and they no longer worry about losing money on the way home.
reading.passage_cn: 在中国，很多人用手机付款而不是现金。你打开支付软件，扫一下店里的二维码，再输入金额，钱一秒钟就从钱包里出去了。小店喜欢这种方式，因为不用准备很多零钱。连在街边卖菜的人也在用。有些爷爷奶奶一开始觉得难，所以孩子们一步一步教他们。现在他们点一下就能买到早餐，也不用再担心回家路上把钱弄丢。

questions.question: What do many people in China use to pay?
questions.explanation_cn: 第一句：many people pay with their phones instead of cash。

questions.question: What do you scan in the shop?
questions.explanation_cn: 第二句：scan the QR code in the shop（扫店里的二维码）。

questions.question: Why do small shops like paying by phone?
options: They do not need to keep much change.
The phone is cheaper than food.
questions.explanation_cn: 第四句：they do not need to keep much change（不用备很多零钱）。

questions.question: Who teaches the grandparents to use the app?
questions.explanation_cn: 倒数第二句：their children teach them step by step。

listening.question: Listen to the dialogue. How much is the story book?
listening.audio_text: Boy: How much is this story book? Woman: It's twenty yuan. You can scan the code on the desk. Boy: Great, I'll pay with my phone.
listening.explanation_cn: 售货员说 It's twenty yuan（二十元），注意 twenty 和 twelve 的读音差别。

listening.question: Listen to the dialogue. What does Grandma think of the app at last?
listening.audio_text: Grandma: I really don't know how to use this app. Boy: Don't worry, Grandma. Just scan the code and type the amount. Grandma: Oh, it's much easier than I thought.
listening.explanation_cn: 奶奶最后说 much easier than I thought（比我原来想的容易多了），这是问「后来觉得怎么样」的答案。

listening.question: Listen and fill in the blank: Small shops do not need to keep much ___.
listening.audio_text: Small shops do not need to keep much change.
listening.explanation_cn: 听到的是 keep much change（备很多零钱），change 在这里是「零钱」的意思。

listening.question: Listen and fill in the blank: The money leaves your ___ in a second.
listening.audio_text: The money leaves your wallet in a second.
listening.explanation_cn: 听到的是 leaves your wallet（离开你的钱包），wallet 读 /ˈwɒlɪt/。

spell.question: 移动的：m______ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: mobile phone 就是手机；mobile 读 /ˈməʊbaɪl/，重音在前。

spell.question: 金额：a_____ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: amount 指金额，读 /əˈmaʊnt/；type the amount 就是输入金额。

spell.question: 收到：r______ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: receive 遵守 i 在 e 前的规则（ei），读 /rɪˈsiːv/。

spell.question: 账户：a______ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: account 有两个 c 连写，读 /əˈkaʊnt/。

mc.question: I can't find ___ skirts I like.
mc.explanation_cn: can't find 是否定，否定句用 any。

mc.question: Why don't we buy ___ books?
mc.explanation_cn: Why don't we…? 是提建议，期待对方答应，这种问句用 some。

mc.question: 用 is / isn't / are / aren't + a / an / some / any 填空：There ___ apples.
mc.explanation_cn: apples 复数 → are；肯定句 → some。
